column1: # Previous mean of top-level PASS records from three successful post-#998
# main-push Go CI runs, refreshed with one passing native-shard sample from
# PR run 43629705788 attempt 1 (Linux X64, retries 0, test-result cache disabled,
# warm Go dependency cache; all four native jobs passed, but the unrelated
# remaining-package job failed). This refresh is for placement only, not issue
# Each current value is 75% of the previous three-run mean and 25% of the new
# passing native-shard sample. Unchanged rows either had no passing sample or
# retained the same value after applying the refresh.
# Unchanged rows use mean top-level PASS seconds; regrouped rows use disjoint
# child PASS seconds where cases moved between top-level tests. Never add child
# durations to their parent when calculating a cost.
